headline: Apple warns of unprecedented memory chip cost increases squeezing margins
summary: Apple warned memory chip costs are rising at an unprecedented rate, driven by strong AI data center demand that is pushing manufacturers toward higher-margin server products. The company's inventory surged 154% to $14.5 billion, and its manufacturing bill is expected to climb by $33 billion. Apple raised prices to offset some impact, even as new CEO John Ternus touted record sales.
